name: How much does a home remodel cost in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does a home remodel cost in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Home remodeling costs in Las Vegas are highly variable, depending on the project type, materials chosen, and the extent of structural changes. A basic bathroom remodel might start around $15,000, while a mid-range kitchen remodel could be $30,000-$60,000. Whole-home renovations can range from $100,000 to several hundred thousand dollars. We offer detailed, transparent estimates after an on-site consultation to understand your specific needs and desires.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodel costs in Las Vegas depend on project scope and materials. Bathroom remodels start around $15,000, kitchens $30,000-$60,000, and whole-home renovations can exceed $100,000.
